location: B-B, 1265; ex V. and J. Mahillon
signature: :   “MACHT. HAINEE HANNS [*****], IN NÜRNBERG, 1668”; master’s mark: cock's head flanked by initials “H.H.”
remarks: Regarding pitch, Fischer 1984: 45, identifies the instrument as a bass; Mahillon 1909: 2: 429 and Tilmans 1978: 2 say it is a tenor. Bell- and slide-stays chased and engraved. Flat bell-stay. Garland has heavy repoussé shell pattern at proximal border; garland engraved with floral pattern, winged cherub’s heads.
